reviews.text: They took pretty much everything that made pkmgo and other gps games good, and made it better. There’s always monsters to fight as there’s a minimum always spawned. Theres never a shortage of shops to buy and sell inventory. However there is no player trading, though the general consensus among the community is that it’s not needed/ will break the game. reviews.title: Good game, can be grindy but that’s part of the fun
reviews.text:
Ive been playing orna off and on for about 2 years, and i’ve got to say it’s come a long way. Many negative reviews of this game come from years back, however the game has made many improvements to balancing out PvP and the grind. You can get to the second highest tier in less than a week if you play constantly. Likewise, you can take your time and enjoy each tier, it’s all up to you and how much time you want to invest. 

Game is COMPLETELY free, anything you can spend money on is optional and solely there to give the dev’s support. There’s no premium currency, no pay-locked classes (technically there are, however they are extremely weak and useless to most players) and the community is friendly.

reviews.title: Everything you could want in a mobile game
reviews.text: I’ve been playing Orna regularly for about 3 months now and I feel it deserves the utmost praise. It’s a simple formula honestly: a high-fantasy themed location based rpg with intuitive and fast turn based combat. The premise alone intrigued me, and it wholly met my expectations. But what I didn’t expect was how flexible this games play style is. Is Orna a game you can sink hours into; grinding and upgrading gear to min max your character to reach end game content? You absolutely can! Is Orna a game you can play casual at your own pace without being competitively obligated to play any other way? Yes! Ornas strength lies in it’s accessibility and was/is (still constantly receiving updates) developed around the players experience. Give this game a try.

I’ve been stuck on kill a lizard boss since basically the first week of playing because I cannot find one. Half the quests I take go uncompleted because the monsters won’t spawn. Territory control feels unreachable because of established high level players that own everything and are untouchable due to said linear progression. 

The most fun part of the game to me is the town building, which is both highly limited and difficult to progress due to a lack of resources.

This isn’t a bad game, just a very mediocre one.

reviews.title: Fantastic mobile game
reviews.text:
Did you enjoy the activity that Pokémon go brought to the world all those years ago, but don’t enjoy having to sit behind a paywall for content in the game? Then boy is this the game for you. 

I’ve been playing this for about 8 months now (which is impressive as I usually only play a game for a few weeks) and I’m loving it. For a GPS based game you can play on the run or at home. I binge my shows and kill monsters that continuously spawn at my house. Yeah, I can’t get world bosses at my place, but I can go for a walk to find those in the world. 10/10 game. I’ve recommended it to multiple people already.

reviews.title: It’s the only game you need to play
reviews.text:
It’s the best mobile game ever made. By far. It’s grindy, it’s long, and there is no pay to win. There is so much to do, and the joke is that if you get past level 200 you never leave. I’ve found this true. So many class and spec choices. So many ways to play the game. Such a great dev. This is a game I’ve played for years and look forward to the next ones. 

It’s a hard game. It’s super fun. It doesn’t require you to spend money. The list can go on. Play it. If it’s for you you’ll be happy you did and you’ve got nothing to lose.

reviews.title: An enjoyable rpg
reviews.text: My brothers and I all downloaded this and have really enjoyed it. We all chose different classes and feel like the game is extremely well balanced but keeps you unique at the same time. Also it’s refreshing to play a game that isn’t pay to win. There are cosmetics you can buy and a few in game things but every aspect of the game can be done without money and still progress almost the exact same. I’ve spent money on the cosmetics because I want to say thanks for making an enjoyable game that everyone can play at their own pace and progress and enjoy. Thank you for this game

reviews.title: AMAZING!
reviews.text: I’m surprised this game hasn’t gotten a lot of attention. I recently got myself into jrpg games and this is satisfying all my needs for one, styled like the Pokémon gps, but has so much depth to keep you invested, with multiple classes/sub-classes, bosses, elements and so much more! There’s a bit of a grind if you don’t go around outside, but there has been plenty to keep me busy in the remote area I live in. I only wish the quests with enemies were slightly more consistent, but besides that I love every aspect this team has brought to the game. Amazing.

reviews.title: Not a good First Impression
reviews.text:
It doesn’t guide you in any form or fashion. You have to dig around the menus to find the first “story” quest. Good luck completing that first story quest anytime soon, as it’s likely going to spawn you as a level 1 and most everything that spawns is 5-10. So spamming potions becomes the norm.

After 1 week I’ve used most of my potions and I’m at level 5. Still can’t kill the level 10 blue slimes the quest requires. Progress is hella slow and combat is very boring at the beginning. Mostly just an exchange of auto attacks and more potion spamming.

Concept is nice, but I can’t recommend the game for new players. If you’ve been playing, sure - the game is neat. But new players seem better off giving this one a pass as they’ve (from what I’ve seen) made changes that made the grind worse.

reviews.title: Very slow. Clans dead.
reviews.text:
Very slow progression. I got into an alliance at level 45 or whatever and I did a whopping 3 damage to one of the team monsters. This game is grind as all get out. Not enough monsters, cknfusing instructions, unreachable quests (looking at you, quest to get a pet by building a pet place. To get a town hall(which is needed first) it’s like a million gold! I’ve been playing for two weeks and am only a third of the way there.). If this is how the small easy game is, then imma bounce.  I’ll give the game another 2 weeks and then quit if things do not approve. 

One MAJOR GRIPE. selecting a focus removes what kingdom you can join. I finally get access to chat after selecting my fire focus. Find a friendly and active kingdom, and they are water so I can’t join. Lovely.

reviews.title: Good GPS game
reviews.text:
Lots of ways to improve, many ways to gather resources, Arena, explore, dungeons, etc,. I wish there were some automation like for encounters I want to be able to hold an option and it just cycles through that until I let go Whether it’s: healing across several turns, using a spell, auto attacking, side arm utilization etc Would help w the more brainless monsters that I know that basic attacks will wipe them
Another gripe, the step counting feature sometimes fails to collect a whole days steps despite having the data collection and letting it run in the background.

reviews.title: Make wars cheaper
reviews.text:
The game is great, and I have been a player for a long time. I’m currently a lv 154 archdruid and I started my own kingdom.

However as a new kingdom with now 8 others and some are inactive, it’s hard to participate in wars. The amount of gold to participate is 20k and I only get a couple for every mob and boss killed. And even if some of my members try and get kingdom gold, it takes too long since some joined but become inactive.

I suggest increasing the amount of kingdom gold earned or make a new way to earn kingdom gold because getting 30 some kingdom gold to save up for  20k gold for a war seems to discourage smaller kingdoms that just formed.

reviews.title: Felt like the devs cared
reviews.text: This game is unique against not only RPGs but all games in general, especially on the App Store. No ads is a good start but it’s not pay to win at all, and you can play VERY casually and still make progress. My only complaint is that the sequel/sibling game is almost identical and yet there is no way to save anything between them even though almost all the mechanics are the same. I get that that is asking for a lot though, so all in all this game looks great, runs great, sounds great, and mostly importantly is free

reviews.title: Some ideas
reviews.text: After playing the game I learned a lot more about it. I think there should be a marker players can build and travel on, for example a flag, for those who play using wifi. Your player base is vastly limited by making people walk to play if they don’t have a phone plan with 4g. You can make it so that people who walk get 20-30% bonus gold and or xp so they are do not feel it’s unfair but there should be a different option for those who want to stay home or play at night to be able to travel the map.

reviews.title: Decent, HUGE down fall.
reviews.text: The game in its self is actually pretty fun. Myself and seven others have started playing this game and the only downfall we can actually find to it, is it at times you get stuck in one location and the game will not update itself to the new location if you are traveling. It does not matter if you turn off service to your phone, or change into Wi-Fi. You can go as far as even turning your phone off with the game closed fully wait for your phone to come back on and you were still in the same place. If this was fixed or if there was a way to fix it on my own, the game would be a four-star or a five.

reviews.title: One of if not the best GPS games
reviews.text: I’m so late to the party. Just found this game in 2024 and it’s crazy how much content and fun there is here. Pokémon Go gameplay in comparison is barren. If you enjoy walking/GPS element of these types of games as well as a more robust RPG system, look no further. There’s so much to talk about that I can’t fit it all in here, but this game really has a lot going for it. The more you play, the more content and mechanics open up. Give it a shot, this developer and game deserves to be known!

reviews.title: GPS spoofing
reviews.text: I really enjoyed the game when I first started playing years ago. Joined a nice group of people and did some coordinated wars together. After we all lost interest due to life happening I had opened up the game after a year to see the whole territory that I live in completely dominated by one account. The guy who controlled the area practically owned the state already which led me to believe he gps spoofed and the new guy gps spoofed to take all the control from him. The discord for the game had a few players even telling people how to spoof so the concept of the game and owning territory is unbalanced for people who play with actual in person traveling.

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: I love this game. It scratches my RPG itch in the best way and has the Pokémon Go charm of being location based, which really lends to the sense of adventure that’s integral to any good RPG. My only criticism, if you can call it that, is that it’s a bit glitchy when updating quest progress. I’ve had to reboot the app a couple of times to force an update of the quest. Very minor complaint though and if fixed, would render this game perfect. This is a must have for any RPG fan.

reviews.title: Solid game but why the price gouging
reviews.text: So the game is solid and it’s fun. I don’t expect niantic quality graphics due to this being a smaller publisher however I also don’t expect the cash shop to be as expensive or more than a large publisher. You aren’t getting the quality your being charged for and that’s sad, I would recommend this to more people if sprites were in the dollar range instead of the 4.99 to 9.99 range too bad about that. It’s even quite obvious that if the cash shop were cheaper the game would have more traction but the sales team is oblivious to what they’re selling if they think they know what they’re doing.

reviews.title: All the Complainers make ma laugh
reviews.text: Everyone complaining about leveling up just doesn’t know how to play games 🤦‍♂️. It’s not hard to achieve T10 (level 225+) in as little as a week without working too hard. I have a T10 and many alts on each tier. Myself and my girl play and enjoy the game. The constant updates are nice and the monthly events keep it worth playing. 99% of the community is also helpful and a great one to be a part of! Keep up the good work!!

reviews.title: MOBILE GAME DONE RIGHT!
reviews.text: Awesome game that really balances grinding while having literally no paywalls or p2p/p2w element. You couldn’t p2w in this game if you tried, great old school feel with the classic looting mechanics but with the new age location based twist rewarding getting out of the house and fighting some bosses! Only things I wish were different were if you could real time fight alongside allies for bosses/raids with buffs for your allies etc. but that is no fault in the game simply a taste preference for me! Definitely a game worth trying out for any rpg style enthusiast!

reviews.title: Some advice to poor review players
reviews.text:
As a lvl 184 attuner/bard in the game I’ve been playing for a while, and almost all the bad reviews about the game being bad are because of user error, go ahead and join the orna discord, lots of people willing to help you there, I’ve never had any problems with anybody on there and it just overall makes the game better

And to all the people complaining that it needs your location, ITS A GPS RPG, YOU NEED TO WALK AROUND TO MOVE INGAME, OFC I NEEDS YOUR LOCATION

reviews.title: Oddly good
reviews.text: For a game that is simple and is using some bought assets (not all) it’s really great.  I’m able to enjoy playing from home and when I’m exploring around town.  I’m glad I’m not 100% forced to have go walking all the time just to play.   I bought the monster sprite pack just to be a Goblin which is fun.  I do wish there was more monster sprite options but I have just started playing at the start of the week I posted this review.

reviews.title: Solid structure of a game
reviews.text: Great game! I love the aesthetic and main theme. I would like to see more content in the future soon, right now it’s lacking in the combat system. Basic turn based with very little skill required; if they add more mechanics to the combat of the game it would be a bit less boring, or just move away from the simple turn based and add something new. But over all I’m still going to continue to play it,  well done.

reviews.title: This game makes me so happy
reviews.text: This is one of my favorite games ever, I play pretty consistently throughout the past few years and take like month long breaks but I always comeback and it updates at a nice consistent rate and it never changes the game in a bad way and the music is so great and there’s so many different things to do, always finding new things to do or change my character or convince my friends to play with me:)

reviews.title: Great game!
reviews.text: I started playing with a friend so we could do something fun while on walks but he chose a different class and we are both disappointed that we can’t trade items. Or that he can’t buy items I sell to shops. I thought maybe if I dropped something he could pick it up, but then I just lost a weapon I could have sold. Also, I frequently have a issue with connecting to the server or everything freezing and losing out on battles and stuff. Will change to 5 stars when some of those are fixed/added.

reviews.title: Few ideas for the game
reviews.text: It is a fun game there is a few issues like there is some lying when finding certain monsters like when your lower level or fighting in raids but one thing I would love to see is trading items between players and When you have a store some of the items don’t show up to grayed out but is a very fun game just some of the Kingdoms require discord one thing They could use something like player chat just a few ideas for a awesome game

reviews.title: Fantastic Game
reviews.text:
One of my friends suggested I try it out and I fell in love with my Dragon Warrior-esque walking game.

Pros:
-Mobs spawn in wild and to where players are meaning you can play whether at home or on the move
-Every 25 Levels unlocks a new tier of play and it can feel very rewarding to suddenly take down that boss or that mob you’ve been struggling with
-Microtransactions are cosmetics or things that don’t really help you progress any faster (but please DO buy the developer some coffee!)
-Community is great!
-RPG mechanics and battles are fun and feel like they get more complicated the higher level you get
-PVP is neat

Cons:
-Honestly I’d just enjoy more sprite options and MAYBE some animations but what’s there is plenty to keep me playing :)

Definitely would recommend to any RPG fan. I love Pokemon (level 40 in Go) but this game is much more my cup of tea.

reviews.title: So much fun, great dev support
reviews.text: A member of my D&D group turned me on to this game about two months ago.  As a previous PoGo player, it is so much of what I liked about that gps based game but combined with my love of RPGs.  This game can be enjoyed alone or with friends as you can find kingdoms to join easily online and every aspect of the game can be enjoyed without spending a dime.  The dev Odie is very supportive, reaching out to the player community on Discord and Reddit for feedback about upcoming updates.

reviews.title: Please URGENTLY FIX!!
reviews.text:
I will change my review after this gets fixed. I’m about to move in two weeks, and there is a glitch “waiting for location” happening. I have to change my hometown, move my shops, etc. I have an iPhone 14, latest update, I have updated this game, restarted my phone and game I’ve done ALL I could think of to help resolve the issues, nothing. Please please PLEASE fix this bug, thanks! 🙏🏻💝

Update: So happy it was finally fixed! Thank you so much!!!! 🥰🙏🏻💖💖💖

reviews.title: Really fun
reviews.text: This game is really fun, especially if you have friends who also play it regularly in a party together. I particularly like that even if you live in the middle of nowhere, there’s still stuff to find and do easily, unlike in Pokémon Go and other games I’ve played like that. The RPG elements are super fun, the classes are neat, and I love the updated ability to do multiplayer dungeons and boss fights. Overall, my favorite game on the App Store!

reviews.title: Good Game
reviews.text: Overall the game is great and fun but I do have one problem. On mobile it runs great and does perfectly but when I downloaded it on my mac and tried to play it, any button I pressed and even when the game started up a tab would open up in google chrome for the game which is annoying because I personally do not want to play the game in the browser. Other than that, its a great game and I would recommend anyome to play it.

reviews.title: Great Game! Would Love Arena Update.
reviews.text:
I have been playing Orna for a couple of weeks now and would just love to say that it was and is definitely worth my time and effort. I got into the game from a friend of mine that told me he enjoyed it far more than other GPS games like Pokémon Go. So far, I couldn’t agree more with his opinion. The game is highly addictive and satisfying as you go about playing. The monsters you battle seem to scale about every 25 levels or so to make sure you are always fighting monsters appropriate to your level. Leveling up is definitely an obstacle later in the game like any other RPG - get ready to grind. 

Unlike Pokémon Go that is biased towards cities for getting ahead quicker, Orna seems to be pretty well balanced everywhere. There is always something you could be doing at every moment regardless if you live in a giant city or out in a small town. There are even dungeons that you can go and vi

reviews.title: Location-based Path of Exile
reviews.text: Great game, would recommend. 2 months in and it encouraged me to get up walking around my town more to hunt for more dungeons. Level 246 right now, and I really enjoy how balanced the progression is- there’s a multitude of different ways to grind and build your character, and they’re all viable! Best of all, the community is tight-knit and extremely helpful! Thanks for all your hard work Odie!

reviews.title: Fantastic game for travelers
reviews.text:
This game is incredible at entertaining you for every type of occasion. You can customize and play with so many different characters/class builds/ and items that you are always thinking and all the while you can just keep on playing the game. 

Wether you like fighting progressively harder  monsters, monsters randomly in the world, bosses summoned/spawned, group activities, or just grinding into oblivion this game offers it all.

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text:
As a say one player of ingress I’ve always enjoyed geo location based games. 
When Pogo was announced I was so excited, but as the time has gone the game felt very stale and boring. 
Orna is the perfect solution for my want to go out and play a game. I missed the capture aspecting in Pogo from ingress and areas and dukedoms are such a nice take on king of the hill. 
If you enjoy RPG and getting out this is the game for you. You can even play indoors for hours and still have fun.

reviews.title: Orna
reviews.text: This is an excellent little game so far I love the way that they’ve adapted Pokémon go into an actual MMORPG. I always wondered if something like this would come out and it’s actually quite fulfilling for a simple as it is and I actually can’t wait to get out of my house and go around and do stuff. I actually want to see what this game has to offer, good job devs. Nice little diamond in the rough you have here.

reviews.title: Breath of fresh air
reviews.text:
I finally deleted Pokémon go but was yearning for an AR game with some actual substance. something that's actually designed for the enjoyment of the player and not to see how much money they can squeeze out of us.

I'm so tired of big name app games that are all about getting money and micro transactions.

Orna RPG is a complex, substantive, highly interactive, well-designed game that is such a breath of fresh air I'M HOOKED

reviews.title: Great game but kinda hoped it be different.
reviews.text: So, like many people I never liked the Pokémon go style of augment reality, I was more into the movement of parallel kingdom and parallel mafia style of RPG. Like I get it this game has a very mindset of it but I wish I can just enjoy the world without moving around. I want to sit and play the game, not be in my phone while I’m outside trying to enjoy some time with friends or family. So I was kinda disappointed to see there is no features to move your character outside of your “radius”

reviews.title: Game play
reviews.text: I love this game so much but when you get to max level and complete the game I know it could take years but 250 feels so low to me and the classes to me are not diverse enough I think there should be branches like the thief can have one where it’s focused on agility or one word it’s focused on attack. Or many other things that would overall better the game.

reviews.title: Please Balance the Gauntlets
reviews.text: This is an amazing game don’t get me wrong. But the dungeons and gauntlets are the MOST rage inducing parts of this game. I would increase each of my main stats by 3(Res, Att, and Def) and my dex plus 1 yet I would have to fight a berserk Nothren Warlock. I literally have no chance to beat it. I would have to use multiple super health potions and I would still lose end up losing all those potions. Please please please make it to where there are either no berserk enemies in dungeons or make it to where they can only be 1 tier down from your current tier.

reviews.title: One of the best game on mobile but
reviews.text: Theres already a lot of strong people that owns territories around me, plus its a gps game. I barely go outside which puts me on a disadvantage. It takes forever to level from level 150 as well which is one of the problems in the game. But overall its a really good game now i play hero of aethric its the almost the same game but not gps

reviews.title: Many ways to play
reviews.text: What I enjoy most about this game compared to other ARG phone games is that you can play from your couch. Obviously you’re rewarded for going out and exploring but you can advance your character without moving if you so choose. It’s nice for me to be able to have a meaningful session while on a break at work or laying in bed

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: This is probably one of the most well made and addictive games I’ve ever played from the App Store. Everything about it is great and I wouldn’t change anything, except for the fact you can’t turn in jobs at any Inn. You can pick up upgraded gear at any blacksmith so I don’t see why you can’t turn in jobs at one of the many Inns, but that’s my only complaint. Besides that it’s perfect!!

reviews.title: Fun but poor pacing
reviews.text:
It’s pretty fun, but new player pacing feels extremely bad.  For what reason do 3 star classes unlock at level 50 when I’m now 78 (4 star classes unlock at 75) and STILL haven’t gotten enough currency to unlock a 3 star.  This is with me completing the quests I can, and trying to do achievements as well.  Either leveling speed needs to DRASTICALLY go down or early run gain needs to go up.

Community is pretty ‘meh’ too.  Asked a question and only ever given was “just play the game”

reviews.title: My thoughts
reviews.text: I really like the game but all I wanted to say is that the classes are a bit imbalanced. Some random class not even on the menu can deal 3,000 damage while the poor mage (my personal choice) can’t even deal 500 without exhausting their only recourse . Plus every other class has what seems like double our hp and resistance so the only reliable kill you can get is against a lower level mage.

reviews.title: Long time gamer and this game is epic.
reviews.text: Everything about this game is epic. The best mobile game in my opinion. It can be extremely buggy at times but any game using real time location is like that. Pokemon go is notorious for bugs. This game is highly competitive and despite the comment before me. Arena battles aren't dumb. Just some people don’t know how to play to the game properly. Been playing since october 2019. Havent stopped yet.

reviews.title: 5/5 game, love to play it every day
reviews.text: I got into Orna through my brother, who got into it from his friend. Ever since, I have adored this game and the unique style and feel of it. One request I have for a patch from version 3.0 is to match up with sparring partners that are not overly hard; I’ve never beaten one of them yet. Other than that, I absolutely love this game. Keep up the great work!

reviews.title: Better than Pokemon go
reviews.text:
If y’all like Elden Ring, Final Fantasy, and Pokemon go. Then this game is for you. The turn based playing style like in Final Fantasy is amazing. Dark fantasy type enemies and the best of all is the Looting in this game.

The UI is great, the gameplay and graphics are great, and the experience is something else. 

Everything is free to play and no ads.

reviews.title: Great game but gets boring
reviews.text: I just started playing this game few days ago and After hunting walking around leveling up its  imposible to take over land around my house this guy *other player * is way to strong . We should be able to travel between dukedoms we own . Capturing or owning dukedoms should be done by defeating boss or guardian first not just driving around and capturing all at once . And keeping Dukedoms should be done by gaining respect*experience* by killing monsters player with more points *hunting* has the rights to own that dukedom .

reviews.title: Great game but…
reviews.text: Great game so far! Really enjoying a lot of the different classes and love that its not pay to win. Pay is simply for cosmetics and a few other small items. One issue I do have though is I cant find Stone… like normal rock. Been days and its a resource you need to build quite a bit but just cant find much compared to wood. Needs a way to better get stone but other than that good game.

reviews.title: AMAZING!
reviews.text: I absolutely love this game. I’ve been playing nonstop since I downloaded it. It’s like a real life rpg experience. I have to go outside to travel to different locations and build my own home town as well and name it. The progression is fun as well. Finding new enemies and fighting different bosses. Overall a very positive experience. 100% recommend this game!

reviews.title: Only for city dwellers
reviews.text: If you live in the country, this game is not for you. Memories are not able to be completed. I can usually get three or four out of the five, but there’s always one or two that can’t be obtained without trespassing.  Tower keys are impossible to find outside of cities.  So after 4 years and 213 levels, I am uninstalling this game.  The grind is just to much for this country guy.  I have watched all my friends level twice as fast because they aren’t ever  having the trouble I have.  Frustration to the max.  So good bye Orna; it’s been real annoying.

reviews.title: Loot System is a deal breaker for me
reviews.text:
**First time user experience who hasn’t left the couch to play YET**

Gear drops are uncommon, drops that are upgrades are ultra rare, gear drops that are upgrades *AND* are useable by your class are omega SS rare. 
First experience with the game, if anyone wants to combat this because they played more therefore know more, it’s irrelevant to the point of sharing first user experience. RPG’s that drop loot you can’t use doesn’t compute in my brain.  

Will update if gain new knowledge that alleviates this issue for me or others.

 I would still recommend. it’s free (ofc has a shop but no pop ups or ads) and interactive with the entire planet, so it is for sure amazing. Haven’t hit a wall yet or really struggled at all, so my problem with the loot drop coding is kinda whatever at this juncture of fighting non elite/boss level monsters.

reviews.title: Mostly okay.
reviews.text: I think this is a neat game with charming graphics, but one of the things that stops me from absolutely loving it is how battles sometimes feel weighted towards the cpu, and I don't like that at all. I know there's supposed to be a challenge, but at the same time things get a little *too* convenient for the cpu especially when I watch them stack status conditions on my character.

reviews.title: Great game, better than other GPS ones
reviews.text:
Orna is a great game. It’s not pay to play at all which is really refreshing.  You can play the game solo, or join communities built around kingdoms for a more social experience. Lots of levels and variety in gear and mobs keeps things fun and gives goals to work towards.  

The developer listens and responds to the community which is probably the very best part.  Thanks, Odie!!

reviews.title: Orna - The GPS RPG Adventure
reviews.text: Classic pixel graphics, a nice soundtrack, and a map that’s an overlay of our actual world. Real time tracking, fight monsters, level up your class, take over areas, build, delve dungeons, kick butts of bosses, and work with your faction and your kingdom to help dominate. Brand new game for the iOS App Store, with nothing but constant updates, and events to fulfill the hearts of many adventurers. Join in the fun! Stormforce for life!

reviews.title: Hud fix iPhone 11
reviews.text:
Using ex potions and dowsing rods trying to close healing interface . Kinda ok because as the exp potions are craftable but dowsing rods are harder to come by. Not sure if you use different interfaces for different systems but either way I love the game enjoy the sprite updates and amazing updates you all constantly provide. 
Thank you for your time.

reviews.title: Please play
reviews.text: This gane is amazing and so fun. Active devs with new and fun updates! This game is worth your time. One thing I may ask for is more items in the Orn shop. I have been playing orna for a while and have had so much enjoyment out of it, you don’t need to spend money. There is no really “game boosting” micro transactions, who ever you can get exclusive versions of characters if you want some swag!

reviews.title: Fun but inconsistent
reviews.text:
I have been playing for a bit and this game is fun. The inconsistencies stem from the relationship between resistance and status elements. The absolute worst negative status is “stun.” It makes no sense and should be reworked or gone completely. 
Also, if you’re new to this game, it is gps driven and very linear. If you don’t travel and move, you will miss out on some content.

reviews.title: Great Title.
reviews.text:
For all of you reading reviews. Don’t trust people who say it takes months to level up after 150. Furthermore don’t trust reviews based solely on their arena experience (arena doesn’t play much of a role besides being something else to do at the moment).

The community is great and if you ever run into any issues the Reddit community is always more than glad to help.

reviews.title: This Game IS Doooooooooope🔥🔥🔥🔥 but….
reviews.text: Got the game 2 days ago already level 72. I’ve been looking for a good rpg for a while even on console but this takes the cake!!! 🙌🏽 the only reason for the low rating was because I bought a storm knight and I don’t see it anywhere!? reviews.title: Needs some work
reviews.text:
I’ve been playing for well over a year, and I’ve noticed one major problem with the game: leveling.
I’m currently a level 128 Spellsword, and the biggest problem I’m facing right now is Orn acquisition. I can not gain attack power without improving my class, which requires around 250,000 orns. Unfortunately, tier 5 enemies only drop around 15-20 orns per kill, which means I have to grind down mobs for HOURS with little progress. Overall, a fun game, but the orn balancing needs to be fixed.

All the buffs I have access to don’t do anything significant enough. I bought you a coffee for the hours I spent but I’m out- this is so unbalanced now and I don’t see a way to progress enjoyably anymore.
